content.short: Multiverse C2C is the fastest-growing multichain decentralized derivatives exchange.
content.description: Multiverse C2C is a decentralized derivatives exchange operating across multiple blockchains, including Arbitrum, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Fantom, Polygon, and OP Mainnet. It was launched in partnership with a leading futures trading platform to address trust concerns in the crypto markets, offering cross-chain access to derivative products through a non-custodial trading experience. The platform aims to provide transparent trading and broaden access to sophisticated financial instruments for a wide range of users.
